title: Provisions of law; waiver.
bodyText: No provision of this chapter may in any way be contravened or set aside by private contract.

annotations.heading: Note
annotations.text: Section applies to all contracts entered into on or after July 1, 2014. L 2014, c 130, §9.

bodyHtml:
[§104-2.7]  Provisions of law; waiver.  No provision of this chapter may in any way be contravened or set aside by private contract. [L 2014, c 130, §1]

 

Note

 

  Section applies to all contracts entered into on or after July 1, 2014.  L 2014, c 130, §9.
